description: Main Roads WA - Bike Count Sites 2017/18 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Western Australia - Main Roads Western Australia. This dataset presents the location of bike count sites in the Perth, Metropolitan Area. This dataset provides the volumes for the latest count year. Bike volumes are collected on a continuous basis at permanent sites on principal shared paths. The Integrated Road Information System (IRIS) Reporting Centre provides a number of other reports. Coverage: Government of Western Australia - Main Roads Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Western Australia - Main Roads Western Australia. Its tags are WA, Western Australia, bicycle, count, points. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
